name: withdrawal-aware-review-gates
title: Wire the existing item-level withdrawal helper into the two REVIEW-path gates
description: withdrawnChecklistItemIdsFrom exists at core/proofstory.ts:1622 and is called only by a smoke test, so evaluateReviewCompleteness (core/proofstory.ts:2084) reads withdrawal at binding and milestone granularity but never at item granularity, and validate-channel.ts has no withdrawal awareness at all. A user-approved withdrawal therefore has no mechanical completion path and the operator must write waivers - prose where proof belongs. Wire both gates through the decision-backed helper, prove an unbacked decisionRef skips nothing, and delete the three B-8df9 waivers this unblocks.
